existing_proofs_preserved: Current original/candidate public contracts use General.FullExactIO for both complete loops at arbitrary positive B and arbitrary N, with finite flat execution, every row output and frame. This supersedes the older N<=B helper restriction. All 216 floating triples retain fp32 x/weight conversion and the explicit fp16 intermediate followed by output conversion; source equivalence changes only pointer multiplication order.

production_stage_mapping.coverage: Both full streamed loops, tails, and explicit intermediate fp16 output cast are represented.
View/allocation, initial width rejection, later forced B16384/8-warps selection and all-row launch are not composed.

dtype_review: Six floating input/weight/output types are materialized. The original wrapper has no matching dtype restriction and y inherits x; additional admitted nonfloating conversion routes or precise rejection cases remain outside that API.
branch_review: Host first checks N against a dtype-size cap, then overwrites BLOCK_SIZE with16384 and num_warps with8. For small-element storage, successful N can exceed16384; current full-loop theorem already covers that, so no single-block defect is alleged. The explicit fp16 intermediate is present even when y is fp32/fp64.

structural_gaps.finding: The wrapper checks a computed width bound before replacing the actual launch block with16384, allocates y and views x before the M-row launch.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: The current full-row kernel proof is not a wrapper theorem for this distinct precheck/override sequence and returned tensor layout.

structural_gaps.finding: Formal Storage has six floating constructors while original x/weight dtype is unrestricted by the wrapper.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: Additional admitted source-to-fp32 and fp16-to-output conversions or precise rejection boundaries are structural cases, not waived by RMS arithmetic assumptions.

numerical_items_eligible_for_explicit_de: Fp32 variance/normalization and casts through the explicit fp16 intermediate may be deferred. The existing exact-real contract erases numeric rounding; the intermediate cast is not removed from typed source.
precondition_assessment: The existing bounds, nonoverlap, positive tile size and valid-address premises are legitimate selected-domain assumptions. No unrestricted invalid-input behavior or hypothetical hardware defect is demanded. Missing wrapper composition and dtype admission are separate structural questions.
